edges.description: The `out` pointer returned by `calloc(sz, sizeof(H3Index))` in `run()` is the same heap buffer consumed by `out[i++] = iter.cell;` in `polygonToCellsExperimental()` on the overlapping-mode path.

The overlapping-mode size estimate `sz` returned by `maxPolygonToCellsSizeExperimental()` is propagated unchanged into `calloc(sz, sizeof(H3Index))`, so the caller allocates exactly the estimated number of output slots.

root_cause_criterion.description: On the `CONTAINMENT_OVERLAPPING` path, the allocated slot count `sz` chosen for `out` must stay strictly greater than the write index `i` that reaches `out[i++]` in `polygonToCellsExperimental()`. The vulnerable execution reaches a write with `i == sz`; the fixed execution writes only while the new bound check keeps `i < size`.
